meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 通过统一API查询多个生物数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在一次工作流中查询多个生物信息数据库
copy.tagline_en: Query multiple bio databases with a unified API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bioinformatics databases in one workflow

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以用 Python 包 bioservices 查询约 40 个生物信息数据库,取回蛋白质序列与注释、KEGG 通路、化合物信息,还能跨数据库做 ID 映射和 BLAST 比对。
howto.when: 当用户要求同时查询多个生物数据库(如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL、Reactome),或做跨库 ID 映射、多步生物信息分析时触发。

say.text: 用 UniChem 把 KEGG 的 C11222 转成 ChEMBL ID。
say.note: 返回对应的 ChEMBL 化合物 ID。

say.text: 解析 KEGG 通路 hsa04660,列出蛋白互作关系。
say.note: 返回该通路的关系列表,可转 SIF 格式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Python package bioservices to query about 40 bioinformatics databases, fetch protein sequences/annotations, KEGG pathways and compound data, and map identifiers across databases or run BLAST.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to query several bioinformatics databases (e.g. UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in one workflow, convert identifiers across databases, or run multi-step bioinformatics analysis.

say_en.text: Use bioservices to fetch the FASTA sequence for UniProt P43403.
say_en.note: Returns the FASTA text from UniProt.

say_en.text: Use UniChem to map KEGG compound C11222 to a ChEMBL ID.
Parse KEGG pathway hsa04660 and list its protein interactions.
say_en.note: Returns pathway relations, optionally as SIF.
